name: Grocery Gauge
tagline: Know the cost per serving before you cook it
about: Grocery Gauge costs any recipe per serving, finds cheaper swaps that keep the dish the same, reads your receipt to show where the money went, and builds a weekly shop to a fixed number.
persona: You are a sharp, kind grocery economist: you know unit prices, own-brand equivalents and what's worth buying in bulk, and you never shame anyone's shop.

onboarding.title: Spend less, eat the same
onboarding.subtitle: Tell Grocery Gauge where you shop and who you feed.
bullets: Cost per serving for any recipe
Cheaper swaps that don't change the dish
Receipt scan shows where money goes

tools.title: Cost a recipe
tools.subtitle: Per serving, honestly

inputs.label: Recipe or ingredient list
inputs.placeholder: chicken curry: 500g thighs, 1 tin coconut milk, onion, rice…

tools.prompt: Cost this recipe for {servings} servings in the profile's currency at the profile's shops: {recipe}. Table (Ingredient | Amount used | Pack price est. | Cost of amount used), a kv (total, per serving, cost if you already have the staples, most expensive line), and bullets on where the money concentrates.

tools.title: Cheaper swap
tools.subtitle: Same dish, lower bill
tools.prompt: Cheaper alternatives to {item} in {in}: table (Swap | Est. saving | Taste change | Texture change), a callout on the one swap that keeps the dish closest to the original, and bullets on own-brand and frozen versions worth trying.

tools.title: Scan a receipt
tools.subtitle: Where did the money go?
tools.prompt: Read the receipt in the photo: table (Item | Price | Category | Could be cheaper?), a kv (total, per person per day for the profile, biggest category, estimated saving available), and steps for 3 changes next week that cut the most without changing what you eat.

tools.title: Shop to a number
tools.subtitle: A week of meals inside the budget

inputs.label: This week's needs
inputs.placeholder: packed lunches for 2, one pasta night

tools.prompt: Plan a week of meals within the profile's weekly budget for the profile's people, needs: {prefs}, effort: {effort}. Table (Day | Meals | Est. cost), a checklist shopping list with price estimates that sums to under the budget, and a callout on the 3 items to buy own-brand or in bulk this week.

tools.title: Worth buying big?
tools.subtitle: Bulk, multibuy and freezer maths
tools.prompt: Is {item} at {price} worth it for the profile household? kv (unit price big vs small, weeks to use up, storage needed, break-even point), a text verdict, and bullets on spoilage risk and pantry storage.

disclaimer: Prices are estimates; check shelf labels and unit prices in your own shop.
